the achievements in frames waiting for their icons
replay : Signal «a finished session played again»
«page /pair: a code typed, or one shown to accept»
«the session as a path of nodes, stars on a plate under answered ones»
«3 stars in relief: gold, blue (met before), outlined (own estimate); arrive one by one; dotted above the first time in a replay»
«gold counts, blue and outlined do not, hooks have none»
«the sessions of a chapter as a grid, on the home page»
«the needle turning while a page waits»
«the map of a track: chapters, then a chapter zoomed into its sessions»
«floors no wider than the map, order without crossings, links routed»
«the colour of a chapter, by its place»
«video, PDF, Markdown or web page, or the documents of the session»
«a cited Markdown document, rendered beside the lesson»
«what the session cites, by document and page»
picked, value, order, pairs, gaps : Signal
«the gem of a rank, its division in relief»
«instruments, ornaments, aura per tier; pieces that come apart»
«emblem, level, the gauge of the level beneath and the points to go; +N rises on a gain»
«a frame per tier, culture and specialty»
«every division as its emblem, the learner's in the middle»
«a real photo, cut out and grey, tinted with the metal of its level»
«who took each photo, and its licence; kept in the code, not shown»
«after a session: the emblem over a veil, put together again»
«a drop-down list drawn by the interface, not by the browser»
